text: The stack is chosen -- Azure SQL Database. Now we plan exactly how ten-plus years of PolicyClaimsDB data gets there: one Data Factory pipeline, two very different jobs.

A one-time bulk copy moves everything that exists today, through a Self-Hosted Integration Runtime since the on-prem server has no public endpoint. An incremental sync then keeps both databases agreeing until the actual cutover.

Most tables sync off a watermark column in a small control table. Policies has no trustworthy modified-date field, so it syncs with SQL Server Change Tracking instead -- catching updates and deletes a watermark would miss.
The cutover itself is written down as a fixed sequence, step by step, with a validation checkpoint and a rollback path that keeps on-prem live until Azure proves itself.
The migration path is mapped. Next: planning the encryption, identity, and auditing this database needs before it ever holds real policyholder data.
